      "source": [
        "## 2. Dataset esteso (con recensioni positive, miste e negative)"
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "pNdU3tn7-GnP",
        "outputId": "6645c20a-9d3a-40b8-eef1-ac7cc6bf4d0e"
      },
      "execution_count": 2,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "✅ 2/7: Dataset generato con recensioni miste e negative (270 recensioni totali).\n"
          ]
        }
      ],
      "source": [
        "np.random.seed(42)\n",
        "\n",
        "libri = ['Beach Read', 'Book Lovers', 'Happy Place', 'Funny Story']\n",
        "\n",
        "# Recensioni sintetiche bilanciate (positive, miste e negative) con Ground Truth per valutazione e clustering\n",
        "data_raw = [\n",
        "    # --- RECENSIONI POSITIVE (Rating 4-5) ---\n",
        "    (\"I absolutely loved the enemies to lovers trope in this book! The banter was witty, fast-paced and amazing.\", \"enemies_to_lovers\", 5),\n",
        "    (\"So emotional, I cried my eyes out at the end. Great second chance romance with high emotional depth.\", \"second_chance\", 5),\n",
        "    (\"The fake dating dynamic was incredible. Such a fun summer read with great dialogue and found family.\", \"fake_dating\", 4),\n",
        "    (\"Classic Emily Henry! Amazing banter and deep emotional stakes between the protagonists.\", \"banter_dialogue\", 5),\n",
        "    (\"Hilarious fake relationship scenario. Highly recommended for rom-com lovers on BookTok!\", \"fake_dating\", 5),\n",
        "    (\"The chemistry between the leads was off the charts! Loved the witty banter and small town setting.\", \"banter_dialogue\", 5),\n",
        "    (\"A masterpiece of modern romance. The enemies to lovers dynamic felt so authentic and grounded.\", \"enemies_to_lovers\", 5),\n",
        "\n",
        "    # --- RECENSIONI MISTE / MEDIE (Rating 3) ---\n",
        "    (\"A bit slow in the middle, but the character development and emotional vulnerability were beautiful.\", \"emotional_depth\", 4),\n",
        "    (\"I hated the misunderstanding trope, but the second chance romance saved the overall story.\", \"second_chance\", 3),\n",
        "    (\"Felt a bit repetitive compared to her previous works, but the emotional depth was heartwarming.\", \"emotional_depth\", 3),\n",
        "    (\"The plot dragged significantly in the second act, making it hard to care about the fake dating plot.\", \"fake_dating\", 3),\n",
        "    (\"Dialogues were sometimes cringey, though the emotional payoff at the end redeemed it slightly.\", \"banter_dialogue\", 3),\n",
        "\n",
        "    # --- RECENSIONI NEGATIVE (Rating 1-2) ---\n",
        "    (\"I really disliked this book. The communication between the main characters was toxic and frustrating.\", \"emotional_depth\", 1),\n",
        "    (\"Total waste of time. The enemies to lovers trope felt forced, childish, and utterly boring.\", \"enemies_to_lovers\", 1),\n",
        "    (\"So disappointing and completely overhyped on BookTok. The second chance romance made no sense.\", \"second_chance\", 2),\n",
        "    (\"I couldn't finish it. The dialogue was flat, repetitive, and the fake dating premise fell completely flat.\", \"fake_dating\", 1),\n",
        "    (\"Painfully predictable and incredibly boring. The emotional depth was entirely missing from start to finish.\", \"emotional_depth\", 2),\n",
        "    (\"Awful pacing and annoying characters. The banter felt forced and the plot went absolutely nowhere.\", \"banter_dialogue\", 1)\n",
        "] * 15  # 270 recensioni totali bilanciate\n",
        "\n",
        "df = pd.DataFrame(data_raw, columns=['review_text', 'ground_truth_trope', 'rating'])\n",
        "df['book_title'] = np.random.choice(libri, size=len(df))\n",
        "\n",
        "print(f\"✅ 2/7: Dataset generato con recensioni miste e negative ({len(df)} recensioni totali).\")"
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "metadata": {
        "id": "HJ7xPPeS-GnR"
      },
      "source": [
        "## 3. Pre-processing e mappatura Trope (Regex)"
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "cRKRmLPj-GnT",
        "outputId": "f3125417-f29f-442d-dfa1-7214d91eda21"
      },
      "execution_count": 3,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "✅ 3/7: Pulizia ed estrazione feature completata.\n"
          ]
        }
      ],
      "source": [
        "def clean_text(text):\n",
        "    if not isinstance(text, str):\n",
        "        return \"\"\n",
        "    text = text.lower()\n",
        "    text = re.sub(r'http\\S+', '', text)\n",
        "    text = re.sub(r'[^a-z\\s]', '', text)\n",
        "    return text\n",
        "\n",
        "df['clean_review'] = df['review_text'].apply(clean_text)\n",
        "\n",
        "tropes_dict = {\n",
        "    'enemies_to_lovers': ['enemies to lovers', 'hate to love', 'rivals'],\n",
        "    'second_chance': ['second chance', 'exes', 'past relationship'],\n",
        "    'fake_dating': ['fake dating', 'fake relationship', 'pretend'],\n",
        "    'banter_dialogue': ['banter', 'witty', 'dialogue', 'funny', 'chemistry'],\n",
        "    'emotional_depth': ['cried', 'emotional', 'heartbreaking', 'vulnerable', 'depth']\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        "for trope, keywords in tropes_dict.items():\n",
        "    pattern = '|'.join(keywords)\n",
        "    df[trope] = df['clean_review'].str.contains(pattern, regex=True).astype(int)\n",
        "\n",
        "def predict_main_trope(row):\n",
        "    for trope in tropes_dict.keys():\n",
        "        if row[trope] == 1:\n",
        "            return trope\n",
        "    return 'emotional_depth'\n",
        "\n",
        "df['predicted_trope'] = df.apply(predict_main_trope, axis=1)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"✅ 3/7: Pulizia ed estrazione feature completata.\")"
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "metadata": {
        "id": "sIbYeP1W-GnW"
      },
      "source": [
        "## 4. TF-IDF e Clustering non supervisionato (K-Means)"
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "metadata": {
        "id": "aDli6eh9-GnX"
      },
      "execution_count": 4,
      "outputs": [],
      "source": [
        "tfidf = TfidfVectorizer(max_features=50, stop_words='english')\n",
        "X = tfidf.fit_transform(df['clean_review'])"
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/",
          "height": 464
        },
        "id": "tQISmHfk-GnZ",
        "outputId": "ef4781f0-e1fb-48e4-8422-4aed2e174f89"
      },
      "execution_count": 5,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "display_data",
          "data": {
            "text/plain": [
              "<Figure size 1200x500 with 2 Axes>"
            ],
            "image/png": "\n"
          },
          "metadata": {}
        }
      ],
      "source": [
        "inertia = []\n",
        "silhouette_scores = []\n",
        "K_range = range(2, 11)\n",
        "\n",
        "for k in K_range:\n",
        "    kmeans_temp = KMeans(n_clusters=k, random_state=42, n_init=10)\n",
        "    kmeans_temp.fit(X)\n",
        "    inertia.append(kmeans_temp.inertia_)\n",
        "    score = silhouette_score(X, kmeans_temp.labels_)\n",
        "    silhouette_scores.append(score)\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(12, 5))\n",
        "plt.subplot(1, 2, 1)\n",
        "plt.plot(K_range, inertia, marker='o', color='b')\n",
        "plt.title('Metodo del Gomito (Elbow Method)')\n",
        "plt.xlabel('Numero di Cluster (K)')\n",
        "plt.ylabel('Inerzia')\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.subplot(1, 2, 2)\n",
        "plt.plot(K_range, silhouette_scores, marker='s', color='g')\n",
        "plt.title('Silhouette Score')\n",
        "plt.xlabel('Numero di Cluster (K)')\n",
        "plt.ylabel('Score')\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.savefig('grafico_elbow_silhouette.png', dpi=300)\n",
        "plt.show()"
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "EkVFgpyH-Gnb",
        "outputId": "c0e8b8cf-c6b2-43fa-83d6-2617f21acc22"
      },
      "execution_count": 6,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "✅ 4/7: TF-IDF, Analisi K e Clustering K-Means applicati!\n"
          ]
        }
      ],
      "source": [
        "kmeans = KMeans(n_clusters=4, random_state=42, n_init=10)\n",
        "df['cluster_kmeans'] = kmeans.fit_predict(X)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"✅ 4/7: TF-IDF, Analisi K e Clustering K-Means applicati!\")"
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "metadata": {
        "id": "MjFJKLli-Gnc"
      },
      "source": [
        "## 5. Sentiment Analysis (VADER) e Softmax con temperatura"
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "SP0-WzPc-Gnd",
        "outputId": "36f0722d-08fb-48fc-ddea-2f237f18cd39"
      },
      "execution_count": 7,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "✅ 5/7: Sentiment Analysis VADER e Softmax calcolati.\n"
          ]
        }
      ],
      "source": [
        "analyzer = SentimentIntensityAnalyzer()\n",
        "df['sentiment_compound'] = df['clean_review'].apply(lambda x: analyzer.polarity_scores(x)['compound'])\n",
        "\n",
        "def softmax_with_temp(scores, temp=1.0):\n",
        "    scores = np.array(scores)\n",
        "    exp_scores = np.exp((scores - np.max(scores)) / temp)\n",
        "    return exp_scores / np.sum(exp_scores)\n",
        "\n",
        "sample_logits = df['sentiment_compound'].head(5).values\n",
        "probs_t_bassa = softmax_with_temp(sample_logits, temp=0.2)\n",
        "probs_t_alta = softmax_with_temp(sample_logits, temp=1.5)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"✅ 5/7: Sentiment Analysis VADER e Softmax calcolati.\")"
      ]
    },
